data.name: Viram
data.gender_notes: Viram is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of the supreme God Vishnu, meaning 'brave', 'valiant', 'victorious'. Viram is a powerful name that evokes courage, strength and the spirit of victory. The name Viram carries the meaning “Brave, Valiant, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Viram usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, valiant, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Viram is believed to invoke the blessings of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe. It is said that those named Viram are endowed with the divine qualities of courage, strength, and the spirit of victory.
data.etymology: Viram belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave, Valiant, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Viram total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Viram is steeped in rich Hindu cultural traditions and holds deep reverence. As a name of Vishnu, the preserver deity, Viram symbolizes the power, bravery, and invincibility of the divine. It is not unusual for parents to name their children this name in the hope that they will inherit these qualities. In various mythological stories, characters with the name Viram have been portrayed as fearless and victorious warriors.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Viram can be understood by delving deeper into the symbolism of the name as a manifestation of Vishnu. Viram represents the brave and fearless aspect of the god, embodying the qualities of courage, strength, and determination to overcome obstacles. It is believed that those who bear this name are spiritual warriors, called upon to face challenges and rise above adversities, drawing upon the divine energy and strength within.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Viram symbolizes courage, bravery, and strength. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vira', meaning hero. It is believed that individuals with this name possess an indomitable spirit and are unyielding in the face of adversity.
